name: Polaris
tagline: A co-op fitness game: friends run, jump and crouch in the living room to steer polar bears.
problem: Home workouts lack the social energy of exercising with friends.
solution: Pose tracking from one camera classifies several players' movements and drives a pixel-art 3D game in the browser.
demo_moment: Team-described: two players jump and crouch to keep their bears alive.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Hack the 6ix: Best Game Hack” among 131 submissions.
Tracks multiple players from a single camera.

lessons: Body-controlled games get judges moving, which wins game prizes.
